scripts.script:
local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://sirius.menu/rayfield'))()

local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
   Name = "ESP Script",
   LoadingTitle = "ESP Rayfield",
   LoadingSubtitle = "Fixed Boxes",
   ConfigurationSaving = { Enabled = false },
   KeySystem = false
})

local Tab = Window:CreateTab("ESP Settings", 4483362458)

local ESP = {
    Boxes = false,
    Tracers = false,
    Names = false,
    BoxColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 136),
    TracerColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
    NameColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
}

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local function createESP(player)
    if player == LocalPlayer then return end

    local box = Drawing.new("Square")
    box.Visible = false
    box.Thickness = 1.5
    box.Filled = false

    local tracer = Drawing.new("Line")
    tracer.Visible = false
    tracer.Thickness = 1

    local name = Drawing.new("Text")
    name.Visible = false
    name.Size = 14
    name.Center = true
    name.Outline = true

    local connection
    connection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        local character = player.Character
        if character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") and character.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
            
    
            local cframe, size = character:GetBoundingBox()
            local hrpPos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(cframe.Position)

            if onScreen then
       
                local topPos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint((cframe * CFrame.new(0, size.Y / 2, 0)).Position)
                local bottomPos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint((cframe * CFrame.new(0, -size.Y / 2, 0)).Position)

                local height = math.abs(topPos.Y - bottomPos.Y)
                local width = height * 0.65

                -- 1. Box ESP
                if ESP.Boxes then
                    box.Size = Vector2.new(width, height)
                    box.Position = Vector2.new(hrpPos.X - width / 2, topPos.Y)
                    box.Color = ESP.BoxColor
                    box.Visible = true
                else
                    box.Visible = false
                end

                -- 2. Tracer ESP
                if ESP.Tracers then
                    tracer.From = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y)
                    tracer.To = Vector2.new(hrpPos.X, bottomPos.Y)
                    tracer.Color = ESP.TracerColor
                    tracer.Visible = true
                else
                    tracer.Visible = false
                end

                -- 3. Name ESP
                if ESP.Names then
                    name.Position = Vector2.new(hrpPos.X, topPos.Y - 16)
                    name.Text = player.DisplayName or player.Name
                    name.Color = ESP.NameColor
                    name.Visible = true
                else
                    name.Visible = false
                end
            else
                box.Visible = false
                tracer.Visible = false
                name.Visible = false
            end
        else
            box.Visible = false
            tracer.Visible = false
            name.Visible = false

            if not Players:FindFirstChild(player.Name) then
                box:Remove()
                tracer:Remove()
                name:Remove()
                connection:Disconnect()
            end
        end
    end)
end

for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    createESP(player)
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(createESP)


Tab:CreateToggle({
   Name = "Enable Boxes",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Callback = function(Value) ESP.Boxes = Value end,
})

Tab:CreateToggle({
   Name = "Enable Tracers",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Callback = function(Value) ESP.Tracers = Value end,
})

Tab:CreateToggle({
   Name = "Enable Names",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Callback = function(Value) ESP.Names = Value end,
})

Tab:CreateColorPicker({
    Name = "Box Color",
    Color = ESP.BoxColor,
    Callback = function(Value) ESP.BoxColor = Value end
})

Tab:CreateColorPicker({
    Name = "Tracer Color",
    Color = ESP.TracerColor,
    Callback = function(Value) ESP.TracerColor = Value end
})

        local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or Instance.new("Animator", humanoid)

    end)

    local linearVel = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")

    local angularVel = Instance.new("AngularVelocity")

    angularVel.AngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 40, 0)
    angularVel.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
    angularVel.Parent = root
    
    task.wait(0.5)

    if animTrack then

            animTrack:Stop()
            animTrack:Destroy()
        end)
    end
    
    isDashing = false
end

scripts.script:
-- Скрипт полёта с красивым синим огнём
-- Создаёт эффект синего пламени при полёте

local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

-- Настройки
local Settings = {
    FlySpeed = 50,
    ToggleKey = Enum.KeyCode.F,  -- Клавиша для включения/выключения
    FireSize = 5,
    FireColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 150, 255),
    FireTransparency = 0.3,
    TrailEnabled = true
}

-- Переменные
local isFlying = false
local flyConnection = nil
local fireEffects = {}
local trailEffect = nil

-- Функция создания огня
local function createFire(parent, position)
    local fire = Instance.new("Fire")
    fire.Size = Settings.FireSize
    fire.Color = Settings.FireColor
    fire.SecondaryColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 100, 200)
    fire.Heat = 15
    fire.Parent = parent
    
    return fire
end

-- Функция создания эффекта следа
local function createTrail()
    local trail = Instance.new("Trail")
    trail.Color = Color3.new(0, 0.6, 1)
    trail.Lifetime = 1
    trail.MinLength = 1
    trail.MaxLength = 10
    trail.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0, 1)
    trail.Parent = rootPart
    return trail
end

-- Функция создания эффектов полёта
local function createFlyEffects()
    -- Огонь на ногах
    local leftFoot = character:FindFirstChild("LeftFoot")
    local rightFoot = character:FindFirstChild("RightFoot")
    
    if leftFoot then
        local fire = createFire(leftFoot, Vector3.new(0, -1, 0))
        table.insert(fireEffects, fire)
    end
    
    if rightFoot then
        local fire = createFire(rightFoot, Vector3.new(0, -1, 0))
        table.insert(fireEffects, fire)
    end
    
    -- Огонь под персонажем
    local groundFire = Instance.new("Part")
    groundFire.Name = "FlyFirePart"
    groundFire.Size = Vector3.new(3, 0.5, 3)
    groundFire.Transparency = 0
    groundFire.CanCollide = false
    groundFire.Anchored = true
    groundFire.Parent = character
    
    local fire = createFire(groundFire, Vector3.new(0, 0, 0))
    table.insert(fireEffects, fire)
    
    -- След
    if Settings.TrailEnabled then
        trailEffect = createTrail()
    end
end

-- Функция удаления эффектов
local function removeFlyEffects()
    for _, fire in ipairs(fireEffects) do
        if fire and fire.Parent then
            fire:Destroy()
        end
    end
    fireEffects = {}
    
    if trailEffect then
        trailEffect:Destroy()
        trailEffect = nil
    end
    
    local groundFire = character:FindFirstChild("FlyFirePart")
    if groundFire then
        groundFire:Destroy()
    end
end

-- Функция включения полёта
local function startFly()
    if isFlying then return end
    
    isFlying = true
    createFlyEffects()
    
    -- Включаем невесомость
    humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Flying)
    humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Falling, false)
    humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping, false)
    
    -- Управление полётом
    flyConnection = game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
        if not isFlying then return end
        
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local moveDirection = Vector3.new()
        
        -- Получаем ввод
        local keyboard = game:GetService("UserInputService")
        
        if keyboard:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
            moveDirection = moveDirection + camera.CFrame.LookVector
        end
        if keyboard:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
            moveDirection = moveDirection - camera.CFrame.LookVector
        end
        if keyboard:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
            moveDirection = moveDirection - camera.CFrame.RightVector
        end
        if keyboard:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
            moveDirection = moveDirection + camera.CFrame.RightVector
        end
        if keyboard:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
            moveDirection = moveDirection + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        end
        if keyboard:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then
            moveDirection = moveDirection - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        end
        
        -- Нормализуем направление
        if moveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
            moveDirection = moveDirection.Unit * Settings.FlySpeed * deltaTime
            rootPart.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame + moveDirection
        end
        
        -- Обновляем позицию огня
        local groundFire = character:FindFirstChild("FlyFirePart")
        if groundFire then
            groundFire.CFrame = CFrame.new(rootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, -2, 0))
        end
        
        -- Анимация огня
        for _, fire in ipairs(fireEffects) do
            if fire and fire.Parent then
                fire.Size = Settings.FireSize + math.sin(tick() * 5) * 0.5
            end
        end
    end)
    
    -- Визуальный эффект запуска
    local particles = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
    particles.Name = "FlyParticles"
    particles.Color = ColorSequence.new(Settings.FireColor)
    particles.Size = NumberSequence.new(1, 3)
    particles.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1)
    particles.Rate = 50
    particles.Speed = NumberRange.new(5, 10)
    particles.Parent = rootPart
    
    -- Эффект свечения
    local pointLight = Instance.new("PointLight")
    pointLight.Color = Settings.FireColor
    pointLight.Brightness = 5
    pointLight.Range = 15
    pointLight.Parent = rootPart
    pointLight.Name = "FlyLight"
    
    print("Полёт включён! Используйте WASD для движения, Space - вверх, Shift - вниз")
end

-- Функция выключения полёта
local function stopFly()
    if not isFlying then return end
    
    isFlying = false
    
    -- Отключаем невесомость
    humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed)
    humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Falling, true)
    humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping, true)
    
    -- Удаляем эффекты
    if flyConnection then
        flyConnection:Disconnect()
        flyConnection = nil
    end
    
    removeFlyEffects()
    
    -- Удаляем частицы и свет
    local particles = rootPart:FindFirstChild("FlyParticles")
    if particles then
        particles:Destroy()
    end
    
    local light = rootPart:FindFirstChild("FlyLight")
    if light then
        light:Destroy()
    end
    
    print("Полёт выключен")
end

-- Переключение полёта
local function toggleFly()
    if isFlying then
        stopFly()
    else
        startFly()
    end
end

-- Обработка нажатия клавиши
game:GetService("UserInputService").InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if not gameProcessed and input.KeyCode == Settings.ToggleKey then
        toggleFly()
    end
end)

-- GUI
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "FlyGUI"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.Parent = player.PlayerGui

local mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 100)
mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -100, 0.9, -50)
mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 40)
mainFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
mainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
mainFrame.Active = true
mainFrame.Draggable = true
mainFrame.Parent = screenGui

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Text = "✨ Полёт с Огнём ✨"
title.TextColor3 = Settings.FireColor
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.TextSize = 16

local function toggleXray(state)
    xrayEnabled = state
    for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("BasePart") and not obj:IsDescendantOf(player.Character or workspace) then
            if state then
                if obj.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" and obj.Name ~= "Head" and obj.Transparency < 1 then
                    obj.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0.7
                end
            else
                obj.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
            end
        end
    end
end

--// ---------- FREE CAM ---------- //
local function stopFreeCam()
    if freeCamConnection then freeCamConnection:Disconnect() freeCamConnection = nil end
    camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
    if player.Character then camera.CameraSubject = player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") end
end

local function startFreeCam()
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return end
    stopFreeCam()
    camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
    local camPos = camera.CFrame.Position
    local camYaw, camPitch = 0, 0
    
    freeCamConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not freeCamEnabled then return end
        if UserInputService.MouseBehavior == Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter then
            local delta = UserInputService:GetMouseDelta()
            camYaw = camYaw - delta.X * 0.003
            camPitch = math.clamp(camPitch - delta.Y * 0.003, -math.rad(89), math.rad(89))
        end
        if fcLookActive and fcLookInput.Magnitude > 0.05 then
            camYaw = camYaw - fcLookInput.X * 0.05
            camPitch = math.clamp(camPitch - fcLookInput.Y * 0.05, -math.rad(89), math.rad(89))
        end
        local rotation = CFrame.Angles(0, camYaw, 0) * CFrame.Angles(camPitch, 0, 0)
        local moveDir = Vector3.zero
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then moveDir += rotation.LookVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then moveDir -= rotation.LookVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then moveDir -= rotation.RightVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then moveDir += rotation.RightVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then moveDir += Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then moveDir -= Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
        if fcMoveActive and fcMoveInput.Magnitude > 0.05 then
            moveDir += rotation.LookVector * (-fcMoveInput.Y)
            moveDir += rotation.RightVector * fcMoveInput.X
        end
        if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then moveDir = moveDir.Unit end
        camPos = camPos + moveDir * freeCamSpeed * (1 / 60)
        camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(camPos) * rotation
    end)
end

local function isEnemy(plr)
    if not teamCheckEnabled then return true end
    if not plr.Team then return true end
    if not player.Team then return true end
    return plr.Team ~= player.Team
end

local function teleportToPlayer(target)
    if not target or target == player or not target.Parent then return end
    local myHrp = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local targetHrp = target.Character and target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myHrp or not targetHrp then return end
    myHrp.CFrame = targetHrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -3)
    myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
    if flying then velocity = Vector3.zero; if bodyVelocity then bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.zero end end
end

            local dist = math.floor((myHrp.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude)
            local inRange = dist <= ESP_MAX_DIST
            if billboard and billboard.Parent and billboard.Enabled ~= inRange then billboard.Enabled = inRange end
            if highlight and highlight.Parent and highlight.Enabled ~= inRange then highlight.Enabled = inRange end
            if not inRange then
                if tpBtn and tpBtn.Parent and tpBtn.Visible then tpBtn.Visible = false end
                if tracer and tracer.Parent and tracer.Visible then tracer.Visible = false end
                return
            end
            local headPos = hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
            local screenPos, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(headPos)
            if onScreen then
                if tpBtn and tpBtn.Parent then
                    tpBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, screenPos.X, 0, screenPos.Y + 55)
                    if not tpBtn.Visible then tpBtn.Visible = true end
                end
            else
                if tpBtn and tpBtn.Parent and tpBtn.Visible then tpBtn.Visible = false end
            end
            if distLabel and distLabel.Parent then distLabel.Text = dist .. " studs" end
            if humanoid and hpBg and hpFill then
                hpBg.Visible = true
                local hp = humanoid.Health / math.max(humanoid.MaxHealth, 1)
                hpFill.Size = UDim2.new(math.clamp(hp, 0, 1), 0, 1, 0)
                hpFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255 * (1 - hp), 255 * hp, 0)
            end
            if tracerEnabled and onScreen then
                local screenSize = camera.ViewportSize
                local startPos = Vector2.new(screenSize.X / 2, screenSize.Y)
                local endPos = Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y)
                local delta = endPos - startPos
                local distance = delta.Magnitude
                local angle = math.atan2(delta.Y, delta.X)
                if tracer and tracer.Parent then
                    if not tracer.Visible then tracer.Visible = true end
                    tracer.Size = UDim2.new(0, distance, 0, 1.5)
                    tracer.Position = UDim2.new(0, (startPos.X + endPos.X) / 2, 0, (startPos.Y + endPos.Y) / 2)
                    tracer.Rotation = math.deg(angle)
                end
            else
                if tracer and tracer.Parent and tracer.Visible then tracer.Visible = false end
            end
        end)
        if not ok then warn("[ESP Loop Error]: " .. tostring(err)) end
    end)

    espConnections[target] = { highlight = highlight, billboard = billboard, tracer = tracer, tpBtn = tpBtn, conn = conn }

local function getClosestTargetToCursor()
    local mousePos = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
    local closest = nil
    local closestDist = aimbotFOV
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= player and isEnemy(plr) then
            local char = plr.Character
            if char then
                local part = char:FindFirstChild(aimbotTargetPart) or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if part and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
                    local screenPos, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
                    if onScreen then
                        local dist = (Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y) - mousePos).Magnitude
                        if dist < closestDist then closestDist = dist; closest = part end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return closest
end

			local args = {[1] = "CreatePart",[2] = "Normal",[3] = cf,[4] = parent}
			_(args)
		end

		function SetName(part, stringg)
			local args = {[1] = "SetName",[2] = {part},[3] = stringg}
			_(args)
		end

		function AddMesh(part)
			local args = {[1] = "CreateMeshes",[2] = {[1] = {["Part"] = part}}}
			_(args)
		end

		function SetMesh(part,meshid)
			local args = {[1] = "SyncMesh",[2] = {[1] = {["Part"] = part,["MeshId"] = "rbxassetid://"..meshid}}}
			_(args)
		end

		function SetTexture(part, texid)
			local args = {[1] = "SyncMesh",[2] = {[1] = {["Part"] = part,["TextureId"] = "rbxassetid://"..texid}}}
			_(args)
		end

		function MeshResize(part,size)
			local args = {[1] = "SyncMesh",[2] = {[1] = {["Part"] = part,["Scale"] = size}}}
			_(args)
		end

		function MovePart(part,cf)
			local args = {[1] = "SyncMove",[2] = {[1] = {["Part"] = part,["CFrame"] = cf}}}
			_(args)
		end

		function SetAnchor(boolean,part)
			local args = {[1] = "SyncAnchor",[2] = {[1] = {["Part"] = part,["Anchored"] = boolean}}}
			_(args)
		end

		function SetCollision(part,boolean)
			local args = {[1] = "SyncCollision",[2] = {[1] = {["Part"] = part,["CanCollide"] = boolean}}}
			_(args)
		end

		function SetLocked(part,boolean)
			local args = {[1] = "SetLocked",[2] = {part},[3] = boolean}
			_(args)
		end

		local e = hrp.CFrame.X
		local f = hrp.CFrame.Y
		local g = hrp.CFrame.Z
		local spawnPos = CFrame.new(math.floor(e), math.floor(f), math.floor(g)) + Vector3.new(0, 6, 0)

		CreatePart(spawnPos, workspace)
		task.wait(0.2)

		local skyPart
		for _, v in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
			if v:IsA("BasePart") and (v.Position - spawnPos.p).Magnitude < 1 then
				skyPart = v
				SetName(v, "RandomSpinSky")
				AddMesh(v)
				SetMesh(v, "111891702759441")
				SetTexture(v,84572918484003 )
				MeshResize(v, Vector3.new(2500, 2500, 2500))
				SetLocked(v, true)
				SetAnchor(true, v)
				SetCollision(v, false)
				break
			end
		end

		if skyPart then
			local t = 0
			local baseSpeed = 230
			local randomness = 230
			runService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
				t = t + dt
				local rotX = math.sin(t * 1.5) * randomness
				local rotY = t * baseSpeed
				local rotZ = math.cos(t * 2.1) * randomness
				local newCf = spawnPos * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(rotX), math.rad(rotY), math.rad(rotZ))
				MovePart(skyPart, newCf)
			end)
		end
	end
end

		-- Create the part
		local createArgs = {"CreatePart", "Normal", baseplatePos, workspace}
		pcall(function()
			if remote:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
				remote:InvokeServer(unpack(createArgs))
			else
				remote:FireServer(unpack(createArgs))
			end
		end)
		
		wait(0.3)
		
		-- Find and modify the baseplate
		for _, v in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
